claim: The niri-ipc client library resolves the socket via the NIRI_SOCKET environment variable (SOCKET_PATH_ENV = "NIRI_SOCKET") in Socket::connect(), but Socket::connect_to(path) accepts any explicit filesystem path — so an out-of-session process that knows the absolute socket path can connect directly without inheriting the session environment.
stance_target: gap-06: cross-session reachability of the niri IPC socket
scope_conditions: niri-ipc crate as used by niri msg; the connecting process needs the socket path (wayland socket name + PID discoverable via /run/user/<uid>/ listing) and same-UID filesystem permission
quoted_support: pub fn connect() -> io::Result<Self> { let socket_path = env::var_os(SOCKET_PATH_ENV).ok_or_else(|| { io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, format!("{SOCKET_PATH_ENV} is not set, are you running this within niri?")) })?; Self::connect_to(socket_path) } ... pub fn connect_to(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> io::Result<Self> { let stream = UnixStream::connect(path.as_ref())?;
